name: Babelland SmarTable for Elementor
author: bbltech

sections.description:
Easily create and customize beautiful, responsive tables directly within the Elementor page builder. SmarTable for Elementor streamlines your design process, eliminating the need for coding or external tools. Elevate your data presentation with an indispensable tool designed for users who seek to enhance their website’s content.

Effortless Table Management:

  • Intuitive WYSIWYG Editor: True “What You See Is What You Get” editing. Design your table in real-time, with no surprises.
  • Flexible Cell Operations: Easily add, delete, merge, and split cells to create the perfect layout.
  • Rich Content Support: Use the text editor to add images, links, and text alongside each other in any cell.
  • Dynamic Content Ready: Incorporate various media elements and dynamic data to make your tables truly engaging.
  • Simple Management: Make quick adjustments for content and structure on the fly.

Rich Style Design:

Transform the appearance of your tables with a variety of styling options that update instantly.

  • Border Options: Fully customize border styles, width, and color for maximum visual appeal.
  • Header Styles: Apply distinct header styles to clearly indicate your table’s structure.
  • Striped Rows: Use alternating row colors to dramatically improve readability.
  • Typography Control: Gain complete styling flexibility over fonts, size, and weight.
  • Text & Background Color: Highlight key content and focus areas with custom colors.
  • Independent Cell Styles: Set unique styles for individual cells for ultimate design control.

Why Upgrade to SmarTable Pro?

The free version of SmarTable is powerful, but SmarTable Pro unlocks the true potential of your table designs with advanced styling and functionality:
